title: Add /live Live Picks page with auth, filtering, and polling

requirements.summary: Ensure /live renders a Live Picks page inside AppLayout and requires Internet Identity login with a responsive card grid and clear empty state.
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to "/live" renders a Live Picks page within the main AppLayout.
If the user is not authenticated, the page shows the existing login-required UI state.
Live picks render as a responsive grid of cards (1 column on small screens, increasing on larger breakpoints).
If there are no picks, the page shows a clear empty state message in English.

file_operations.description: Confirm the "/live" route is registered and wrapped with the existing auth gate (RequireAuth) so unauthenticated users see the existing LoginRequiredState. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure the Live Picks page content is rendered within the existing AppLayout flow and that the unauthenticated state relies on the existing login-required UI state (via RequireAuth/LoginRequiredState). Keep/confirm an English empty state when no picks are available. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Confirm/adjust responsive grid breakpoints for card layout (1 col small, increasing on larger screens) and ensure an English empty state is shown when there are no picks to render. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add search and status filter controls on Live Picks that jointly filter the visible cards and show an empty results message.
acceptanceCriteria: Search input filters picks by player name or team (case-insensitive).
Status filter can switch between All, Live, Final, and Upcoming and updates the displayed cards accordingly.
When no picks match filters, show an in-grid empty results message in English.

file_operations.description: Wire search (player/team, case-insensitive) and status filtering to work together when computing the displayed picks list; ensure the UI clearly reflects filters and the filtered list drives the grid. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Confirm the filter options and labels map to the backend GameStatus values and include All/Live/Final/Upcoming. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Update the empty-results rendering to be an in-grid message (English) when the filtered list is empty (distinct from the overall 'no picks available' page-level empty state). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Fetch live picks with periodic polling and show standard loading/error states plus a human-friendly Last updated timestamp when available.
acceptanceCriteria: While fetching, show a loading state with English text (e.g., "Loading live picks...").
If the query fails, show the existing error UI state.
Live picks refresh automatically on an interval (polling) without requiring manual page reload.
If a last-updated timestamp is available from the backend, display it on the page in human-friendly relative time (English).

file_operations.description: Ensure live picks data is fetched via React Query with polling enabled while actor+identity are available, and that failures propagate to the page for standard error UI. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure the last-updated timestamp is fetched via React Query with polling enabled while actor+identity are available, and that failures propagate to the page for standard error UI. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Show the standard loading UI while queries are in-flight; if any of the Live Picks fetches fail (picks/timestamp/diagnostics), render the existing ErrorState; and display a human-friendly relative "Last updated" when a non-zero timestamp is available. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
